subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as a core sensitive-state artifact contract now, or keep this draft waiting for Scout/Lobster pilot and stress-harness evidence?
rationale: The branch adds a new core backup/storage command and artifact schema for sensitive SQLite state; automation can identify code defects but cannot choose the permanent core-versus-host contract or required proof threshold.

options.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Proof
options.body: Require the lockfile and stale-policy fixes first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.

options.title: Land Core MVP After Cleanup
options.body: Accept the local-only core command once concrete blockers are fixed and product/security reviewers explicitly approve the sensitive artifact boundary.

options.title: Defer To Host Or Plugin Path
options.body: Keep the artifact flow outside core until a missing OpenClaw API or broader backup strategy proves the command belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Proof
recommendation.body: Require the lockfile and stale-policy fixes first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.

likelyOwner.reason: galiniliev is the current assignee and already reviewed the snapshot artifact contract and its remaining proof boundary.
